findings.message: This element ("Boston.gov An official website of the City of Boston. Here'…") takes keyboard focus and listens to click, keydown, so it works as a control, but the browser exposes it as LabelText, with no control role: a screen reader does not announce it as a button or a link (F59). Use the native element (button, a) or give it the role of the control it is.
